items.exampleEn: Please open your book to page ten.
How many languages can you speak?
I read an article about health.
items.exampleZh: 我讀了一篇關於健康的文章。

items.exampleEn: This section of the test is easy.
items.exampleZh: 考試的這一部分很簡單。

items.exampleEn: Can you give me an example?
We do fun things in science class.
items.exampleZh: 我們在自然課上做有趣的事。

items.sentenceEn: Please write your answer on page two.
items.sentenceZh: 請把你的答案寫在第二頁。

items.audioEn: Read the article on page five. Then answer the questions.
items.audioZh: 讀第五頁的文章，然後回答問題。
items.questionZh: 說話者要你讀哪一頁的文章？

items.sentenceZh: 英文是一種重要的語言。

items.sentenceEn: Put your name on the list.
items.sentenceZh: 把你的名字寫在名單上。

items.stemEn: For ____, apples and bananas are fruit.
items.stemZh: 例如，蘋果和香蕉都是水果。

items.stemEn: She speaks three ____: English, Chinese, and Japanese.
items.stemZh: 她會說三種語言：英文、中文和日文。

items.passageEn: Amy writes articles for the school newspaper. This week, her article is about science. It has three sections. In each section, she gives an example of science in our everyday life. There is also a list of questions at the end.
items.passageZh: Amy 幫校刊寫文章。這週她的文章是關於科學的，分成三個部分。每個部分她都舉了一個日常生活中的科學例子。文章最後還有一串問題。

questions.questionZh: Amy 這週的文章是關於什麼？

referenceEn: This article is on page three.
rubricZh: 「在第三頁」可寫 on page three（這時 page 前不加 the），也可寫 on the third page
寫數字 3 或英文 three 都可以

items.instructionZh: 用 answer 造一個句子（當名詞或動詞都可以），說說回答問題的事。
referenceEn: I know the answer to this question.
I always answer my emails quickly.
rubricZh: answer 當名詞常用 the answer to…（例如 the answer to this question）
answer 當動詞直接接受詞（例如 answer my emails）
